name: Kamikubo Juria
source:
Your typical J-idol with stars in her eyes, gunning for the big screen.
Don't let her looks fool you - she's got an old head on young shoulders, always working the angles and tough as nails.

"So, what's the word on the street about Teru-kun and me? I'm curious."

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]
